context_requirements: Expression of retinoic acid receptors (RARA, RARB, RARG) or retinoid X receptors (RXRA, RXRB, RXRG)
Intact retinoic acid signaling and coactivator/corepressor machinery
Cellular ability to metabolize or respond to retinoids (e.g., ALDH1A, CYP26 expression)
Hormone-responsive lineage (e.g., breast, colon, melanoma) for strong transcriptional effects
falsifiers: No change in canonical retinoic acid target genes (e.g., RBP1, LRAT, CYP26A1, RARB) at 6 or 24 hours in any cell line
Strong upregulation of proliferation genes or absence of growth arrest at 24 hours across all lines
Lack of any dose-dependent or time-dependent transcriptional response in MCF7 or other retinoid-sensitive lines
Predominant induction of generic stress responses (heat shock, unfolded protein response) without retinoid target modulation

changes: Removed TGFB3 from proximal_down because TGFB3 is a known retinoid-inducible gene and is listed in late_up; a gene cannot be both up and down at the same time.
Removed GADD45A from late_up because it is a generic stress/apoptosis gene rather than a specific proximal retinoid receptor target.
Removed CDKN1A from late_up because it is a generic cell-cycle arrest gene rather than a specific proximal retinoid receptor target.
Removed CEBPA and CEBPD from late_up because they are generic differentiation/stress genes rather than specific proximal retinoid receptor targets.
Removed IGFBP3, SERPINE1, TIMP2, COL1A1, and COL4A1 from late_up because they are generic extracellular matrix or growth-factor-binding genes rather than specific proximal retinoid receptor targets.
Removed apoptosis from generic_effects because the hypothesis provides no evidence for apoptosis and retinoid receptor ligands more commonly cause differentiation or growth arrest.
Changed line_response for A549 from moderate to weak because A549 has mutant KRAS and is not a classic retinoid-sensitive line.
Changed line_response for HT29 from moderate to weak because HT29 has mutant BRAF and is not a classic retinoid-sensitive line.
Changed line_response for A375 from moderate to weak because A375 has mutant BRAF and is not a classic retinoid-sensitive line.
Changed line_response for HCC515 from moderate to weak because HCC515 is not a well-characterized retinoid-sensitive line.
Changed line_response for HEPG2 from weak to moderate because HEPG2 is a hepatoma line with intact retinoid signaling and can respond to retinoids.
Changed line_response for PC3 from weak to moderate because PC3 is a prostate cancer line that can respond to retinoids.
Changed line_response for VCAP from weak to moderate because VCAP is a prostate cancer line that can respond to retinoids.
